arguments.sql: SELECT c.mcc, c.description, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id JOIN mcc_codes c ON m.mcc = c.mcc WHERE c.description = 'Passenger Railways' GROUP BY c.mcc, c.description ORDER BY c.mcc, c.description
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions for each MCC code described as 'Passenger Railways', one row per code.
assumptions: Counts every transaction, labelled or not, since the request asks for a transaction count rather than a fraud rate.
Matches the description 'Passenger Railways' exactly, as case-sensitive text.
Covers the full data period, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
